theorem S2_le_54 {α x Q : ℝ} {a k : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hcop : IsCoprime a (q : ℤ))
    (hα : |2 * α - a / q - k| ≤ 1 / (q * Q)) (hx : 0 < x) {U V : ℕ}
    (hV : (2000000 : ℝ) ≤ V) (hQ : 3.5 * (x / U) ≤ Q) {A : ℝ} (hVA : (V : ℝ) ≤ A)
    (hqA : 2 * q * rexp 1 ≤ A) {W : ℝ} (hW : W ∈ Set.Icc A (x / U)) :
    S2 α x (max U (x / (2 * W))) (max V (W / 2)) W ≤
      (1 / 4 * x / (Nat.totient q * Real.log (W / (2 * q))) +
        q / Nat.totient q * (W / Real.log (W / (2 * q)))) * logSqSum (max V (W / 2)) W :=

note: Lean keeps H₂ here, as [H] does, and requires Q ≥ 3.5x/U for (5.54), which the book does not check. Erratum: The factor x/(4 phi(q) log(W/2q)) in (6.23) comes from (5.54), which is proved only for Q >= 3.5W. (checked by `scripts/checks/eq_6_23.py`).
